description: Static connect options for MMIR.ai. These are safe frontend options only; secrets and provisioning belong to protected backend services.

options.title: Connect local LLM
options.description: Use a local connector to make models running on your PC or private VM available to MMIR.ai without exposing raw runtimes publicly.

options.title: Add compatible backend
options.description: Add a trusted MMIR-compatible backend URL for models, status and chat once your connector/API is ready.

options.title: Use SaaS model/API
options.description: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and similar provider APIs require a protected backend or vault. Do not paste real keys into the public frontend.

options.title: Request VM/GPU capacity
options.description: Future managed capacity can provision CPU, RAM or GPU through protected backend/IaC workflows with cost controls.
